facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 66°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: The nearby stations disagree about this year: snow left Jump Off Joe (3,530 ft) 13 days earlier and Bear Grass (4,720 ft) 47 days earlier than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Jump Off Joe
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 15 (2023), April 16 (2024), April 10 (2025)

evidence.name: Bear Grass
evidence.detail: left April 23; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 9 (2024), June 6 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Jump Off Joe (3,530 ft) and Bear Grass (4,720 ft).

evidence.name: Jump Off Joe
evidence.detail: 0.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 19.5 in (2023), 4.9 in (2024), 3.8 in (2025)

evidence.name: Bear Grass
evidence.detail: 6.3 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 83.0 in (2023), 45.2 in (2024), 67.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 20 and May 11, carried from the melt-out dates at Jump Off Joe (3,530 ft) and Bear Grass (4,720 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Jump Off Joe
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 706 ft below the pass; points to March 20 to May 12

evidence.name: Bear Grass
evidence.detail: melted out April 23, 484 ft above the pass; points to March 20 to May 10
